localBiteReport: The most current report covering Choctawhatchee Bay and the Destin area (dated September 18–24, 2026, published within the last 24 hours) shows a strong fall transition underway. Around Destin, an abundance of bait in the bay is fueling solid action on redfish, flounder, and trout, with local guide Capt. Adam Schroeder calling the inshore bite one of the best he's seen all year. Redfish are the standout species, with slot fish and oversized bulls spread from Destin Pass into the main bay; live scaled sardines, shrimp, and croakers are the top baits, and tidal movement around structure is the key timing factor. Trout and flounder are also actively feeding alongside the redfish, and the fall bait migration is still building — conditions should hold or improve in the coming weeks. Water temperature at this location is currently 86°F.
